data.name: Dhrumit
data.gender_notes: Dhrumit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhrumit is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhruma’ which means ‘moving,’ ‘vibrating,’ or ‘ruler.’ In Hindu mythology, Dhrumit is considered a fearless and powerful name, evoking the strength and stability of the earth. The name Dhrumit carries the meaning “Fearless, Ruler of the Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhrumit usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless, ruler of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace courage and stability in your life journey.
